scripts.dev:backend: uv run --directory backend --locked uvicorn swp.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --timeout-keep-alive 75 --no-access-log --reload --reload-dir swp
scripts.e2e:serve: npm run build --workspace frontend && concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "npm:e2e:backend" "npm:e2e:frontend"
scripts.e2e:backend: npm run e2e:reset-db && uv run --directory backend --locked swp db upgrade && uv run --directory backend --locked uvicorn swp.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --timeout-keep-alive 75 --workers 4
scripts.e2e:reset-db: node -e "for (const f of ['e2e.db', 'e2e.db-journal', 'e2e.db-wal', 'e2e.db-shm']) require('fs').rmSync(require('path').join('backend', 'var', f), { force: true })"
scripts.test: npm run test:py && npm run test:web
scripts.gen:api: uv run --directory backend --locked swp openapi | npm exec --workspace frontend -- openapi-typescript -o lib/api/schema.ts
